water_evidence: No verified separate water class. Actual pale/white/blue source geological swatches and narrow native hydrographic linework are retained as uncertain color references, not globally removed or uniquely interpreted. Scan remains authoritative for linework.

method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
